line: call    TESTopic__SelectInfoForSpeaker; Authoritative Oblivion INFO selector. Scans running quest buckets by descending priority and INFOs in record order; applies conditions, conversation linkedFrom/ANY rules, reuse suppression, and Random groups. For an ambient first item (previousTopic=null), a nonempty linkedFrom list is rejected unless the target is the player. RandomEnd is latched before conversation reuse checks, so a duplicate/repeated RandomEnd INFO can terminate the scan without being eligible.
